commit.message:
Connect Soma360 SPA to the deployed cross-origin API

Point the production build at https://library-system-jdge.onrender.com
via VITE_API_BASE_URL, and make both ends work cross-site:

- Frontend: resolve /health against the API origin; take the CSRF token
  from the /auth/csrf response body (cross-origin JS cannot read the
  cookie) and reset it on sign-out; add .env.production/.env.example.
- Backend: COOKIE_SAME_SITE (none+secure for a cross-site SPA), shared
  cookie options, no CSRF rotation at sign-in, CORP cross-origin.
- Docs: cross-origin wiring, Render env values, and the third-party
  cookie caveat.
